title: The Owl House
tagline: Us weirdos have to stick together.
synopsis: Luz, a self-assured teenage human girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical new world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King.

episodes.title: A Lying Witch and a Warden
episodes.synopsis: Luz, a self-assured teenage girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King. In order to get home, Luz must help them with a mission.

episodes.title: Witches Before Wizards
episodes.synopsis: When an ancient wizard gives Luz a map for a mystical quest, she wonders if she is actually a Chosen One.

episodes.title: I Was a Teenage Abomination
episodes.synopsis: Luz sneaks into the local magic school to help a friend and makes a new enemy in the process.

episodes.title: The Intruder
episodes.synopsis: Luz and King have to defend the Owl House from a mysterious intruder.

episodes.title: Covention
episodes.synopsis: Luz's lesson about witch covens goes awry when she finds herself thrust into a witch's duel.

episodes.title: Hooty's Moving Hassle
episodes.synopsis: When Luz, Willow and Gus accidentally animate the Owl House, the house runs amok around Bonesborough.

episodes.title: Lost in Language
episodes.synopsis: While checking out the library, Luz's pranks lead to unintended consequences.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Swap
episodes.synopsis: A simple disagreement leads to a complex situation when Eda, King, and Luz triple-down on a wager.

episodes.title: Something Ventured, Someone Framed
episodes.synopsis: When Gus sneaks Luz into Hexside School to present at the Human Appreciation Society, Luz sees a side of the school she didn't expect.

episodes.title: Escape of the Palisman
episodes.synopsis: When an adventure with Eda's staff goes awry, Luz and her friends have to earn the staff back from a mysterious forest creature, or lose the staff forever.

episodes.title: Sense and Insensitivity
episodes.synopsis: When King becomes a bestselling author, he learns a valuable lesson in reading the fine print.

episodes.title: Adventures in the Elements
episodes.synopsis: Luz needs to learn a new spell, so Eda takes her to the most magical place on the island to train.

episodes.title: Separate Tides
episodes.synopsis: Luz feels guilty about Eda losing her powers, so she sets sail in search of a lucrative bounty to help the Owl House.

episodes.title: Escaping Expulsion
episodes.synopsis: When Amity's parents get Luz, Willow and Gus expelled from Hexside, Luz strikes a dangerous deal with them to get back into school.

episodes.title: Echoes of the Past
episodes.synopsis: King's delusions of grandeur lead Luz, Lilith, and Hooty to a dangerous new island.

episodes.title: Keeping Up A-fear-ances
episodes.synopsis: Eda gets an unwelcome visit from a family member who puts a strain on everyone in the Owl House.

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass Ruins
episodes.synopsis: Gus tries to impress a group of cool kids from Glandus High, while Luz and Amity journey into the most dangerous section of the library.

episodes.title: Hunting Palismen
episodes.synopsis: It’s Palisman Pairing Day at Hexside, but Luz doesn’t match with a Palisman of her own and soon finds herself on an unexpected journey with a foe.

episodes.title: Eda's Requiem
episodes.synopsis: A special witch from Eda’s past enlists her in a rebellion against the Emperor.

episodes.title: Knock, Knock, Knockin' on Hooty's Door
episodes.synopsis: Hooty tries to help King, Eda and Luz with their problems, but it doesn’t go as planned.

episodes.title: Eclipse Lake
episodes.synopsis: When Luz gets sick with the Common Mold, it's up to Amity to find an important ingredient for the portal door - but Amity's not the only one on its trail.

episodes.title: Yesterday's Lie
episodes.synopsis: Luz thinks she's found a way back home. But is she ready for what she'll find on the other side?

episodes.title: Follies at the Coven Day Parade
episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of her trip home, Luz takes on daring rescue missions during the Coven Day parade.

episodes.title: Elsewhere and Elsewhen
episodes.synopsis: Luz is desperate for more information about Philip Wittebane, the creator of the portal door. With Lilith's help, she sets off on a journey for the ages.

episodes.title: Thanks to Them
episodes.synopsis: After months of trying, Luz and her friends make a daring attempt to return to the Demon Realm.

episodes.title: For the Future
episodes.synopsis: Luz and her friends race against Belos to confront the Collector and save the Boiling Isles.

episodes.title: Watching and Dreaming
episodes.synopsis: The fate of the Boiling Isles rests on the shoulders of a human, a cursed witch and a little King.
